review.alternative: Governance could be handled through heuristic software agents.

claims.statement: WAKE governance acts as the mechanical authority between untrusted proposals and durable state.

support.explanation: The governance module enforces deterministic permissions on model proposals.
support.passage: This module is the mechanical authority between untrusted proposals and durable state. Intelligence may suggest a transition. Only these deterministic rules decide whether the transition is permitted.

review.alternative: Mutable state tables could provide process continuity.
review.would_change_mind: Evidence of mutable table architecture in core records.

claims.statement: The durable record uses an append-only event container to store authoritative history.

support.explanation: State is maintained via append-only event logs rather than mutable records.
support.passage: SQLite is used as a durable append-only event container, not as a mutable table of current objects.

actions.findings:
WAKE governance acts as the mechanical authority between untrusted proposals and durable state. [source-483d42b85ac84c4e]

The durable record uses an append-only event container to store authoritative history. [source-db6ad8d423a74a1e]
actions.limitations: Analysis is limited to source-code inspection of record and governance modules without live execution traces.
actions.next_questions: How do append-only event containers scale under high-frequency proposal rates?
actions.reason: Revising prior findings with substantive code excerpts from governance, history, and record modules.
actions.summary: An examination of how deterministic governance modules and append-only event containers enforce state persistence across stateless model invocations.
actions.title: Kernel Governance and Durable Record Mechanisms for WAKE Process Continuity
